use_when.statement: Use a badge to label a status or category the user reads, not clicks — a category tag, a status pill, a "Most popular" flag.
use_when.verbatim: Use a badge to label a status or category the user reads, not clicks — a category tag, a status pill, a "Most popular" flag.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t use it for something the user can interact with; use Chip for that.

placement.statement: in a card header Action slot, and in a table cell or list row as a status

a11y.fact: renders a <span>, so it is not focusable and carries no interactive role — the set defines no interaction state because a badge is read, not clicked
